title: Design: Credit Terms Log load error looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: The credit terms history cannot be loaded, and you compare the error with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The log cannot be loaded (the setup file says how to make it fail on the test shop).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-16-credit-terms-log-could-not-load.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" button beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the page menu opens.
  • Step 2: the table shows no rows and, in place of the empty line, "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again."; a red alert at the bottom right with a warning triangle reads the same sentence with "Close"; the Credit Terms page behind is unchanged (as in ct-p1-16-credit-terms-log-could-not-load.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

The picture's caption says the build differs from the PRD; PRD v3 now says exactly what the picture shows (register CT-D08, settled).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log fails to load | "Something went wrong loading the Credit Terms Log. Please try again." | Standard error alert; the table shows no rows and repeats the same sentence in place of the empty-state line”
